title: Boost Meter
prompt:
Your car starts a kickoff with **33 boost**. Boost can never go above **100** or below **0**.

Input: the first line is `n`, the number of events. Each of the next `n` lines is one event:
- `pad X`: you picked up a pad worth `X` boost (12 for small, 100 for big)
- `use X`: you tried to spend `X` boost (you can't spend more than you have)

Print the boost amount after every event, one per line.
tutorNotes: Trains clamping and reading structured input with cin >> word >> number. Common mistakes: clamping only on one side, clamping after printing instead of before, starting at 0 instead of 33, using getline then failing to parse. A clean solution uses std::min/std::max or std::clamp (C++17).
